theme: Inferring the path from only the destination
title: Kinetics From the Endpoint: A Perturbation Budget
strategies: empty budget: request zero perturbations and report nothing (reproduces the checker's own baseline; trivial)

highest-flux-first edge scan: sort ALL nodes by individual flux weight and probe the top Q, oblivious to which nodes are already unique (singleton clusters, zero benefit from probing) and which share a confounded product subset with several siblings (a lone probe there separates nothing) (greedy / obvious textbook recipe)

budget-aware cluster separation: partition nodes by their exact product subset (purely structural, no hidden data needed), skip already-unique singletons for free, and solve a small 0/1 knapsack over the remaining clusters (cost = clustersize-1, value = cluster flux) to choose WHICH clusters to fully separate under the budget -- exploiting that an oversized cluster costing more than the whole remaining budget is a trap, while several smaller clusters fit the same budget for strictly more resolved flux (strong; exploits the planted structure)
adaptive/multi-round query design informed by partial reconstruction residuals beyond a single structural knapsack pass (open ceiling, uncovered)
